steps.note: Rows with missing Production/Area dropped (target cannot be computed).
Exact duplicates and duplicate State/District/Year/Season/Crop keys removed.
Rows with zero Production or Area dropped (ambiguous: failure vs. non-reporting).
Coconut: Production reported in number of nuts, not tonnes; Sannhamp: Production unit (bales vs tonnes) is ambiguous in the source; Oilseeds total: Aggregate of other crops, not a crop
Inner join on State + Crop_Year. States/years without a rainfall record (e.g. Rajasthan, Chandigarh, A&N Islands, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Telangana before 2013) are excluded rather than imputed.
Crops with fewer than 1000 records removed.
Area < 1 ha removed; per-crop log-yield outside [Q1 - 3·IQR, Q3 + 3·IQR] removed.

dropped.Production: Used to compute the target (Yield = Production / Area) -> data leakage.
dropped.Fertilizer, Pesticide: In the Kaggle state file these equal Area x a single constant per year (Fertilizer/Area identical for every row in a year: e.g. 1997 = 95.17). They carry no information beyond Area and Year and are not real measurements.
dropped.Kaggle Yield column: Does not equal Production/Area for most rows; Yield is recomputed.
dropped.Temperature, humidity, soil N/P/K, pH: Not present in any source that can be matched by district and year; not used and not invented.
